correctness.rationale: Exact 6-cycle-to-ordered-three-column assignment proves the cubic Walsh formula with correct orientation normalization. Four independent uniform local types give multinomial coefficients and Fourier kernel norm. Every edge is in 2(n-1)(n-2) six-cycles, proving universal W≡2 mod4 for n≡3 mod4; a complete parity split of the three half-sums proves W≡8 mod16 for n≡6 mod8. The independent-column vector has mean zero, identity covariance, bounded moments, and CLT with uniform integrability yields the constant (2/pi)^(3/2). The actual package checker computes every Walsh coefficient by FWHT for n=3..6 and verifies binomial/Parseval/residues through n=70. Infinite claim uses analytic proof, not finite tests.
